headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.35
summary: This release resolves an issue when installing app updates and refreshes the documentation site while staying synchronized with upstream updates.

items.text: Stream APK updates directly to the package manager instead of passing a private file path.
Migrate the documentation site to levimc-kit using Impression and Craft.
Enable GitHub Pages and configure automated documentation deployment.
Synchronize the main branch with upstream updates while preserving fork workflows.
Restore R8 mapping file uploads during the release build process.
Improve repository synchronization workflows to automatically track upstream changes and conflicts.
